verification.method: scripts/verify/iran.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank, share, growth, density, land area
Fertility 1980/1990/2000/2026: the largest 1980–2000 fall among countries over 10 million; under 2.1 since 1999; 1959 high
Births 1985 peak (over 2 million) and now (about half); median age 2000/2026/2050
Peak 2053, natural loss from 2054, decline every later year, 2100 total at the 2013 level; only decline in 1993 with net outflow; growth mostly natural
UN grouping in Southern Asia, fourth after India, Pakistan, Bangladesh; life expectancy second after the Maldives; urban share; title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
